note: The pinned frontend-design reference (color-and-contrast.md) states large text as '18px+ or 14px bold'. WCAG defines large text as 18pt (24 CSS px) or 14pt bold (18.6667 CSS px). The rough mockup applies the WCAG values: only text at 24px+ regular or 18.6667px+ bold may use the 3:1 large-text minimum; all other text targets 4.5:1. The pinned source file was not edited.
